Conditional accounting Step/Trace induction and gate arithmetic; no C weak-memory refinement
Backend result captured before completion release publication; caller delivery is separate; raw effect before capture remains unqueryable without a qualified cooperative adapter
Exact operation/domain/block/grant generations and one gate jointly apply charge and consumed state; replay only queries completion; no duplicate free or credit
Same short domain gate protects owner, revisions, intents, writer and sweep leases and admission; pending native calls exclude commit; no raw allocation, finalizer or GC under gate

Retire and unique release permit under gate after scan/root/raw-reader closure; native call outside gate; unknown outcome retains charge and release exclusion; metadata outlives payload without raw authority
Pre-register one exact allocation intent and extent; preserve unknown malloc/free outcomes and capacity custody; refund only unique no-block/closed-call evidence, not stop alone or timeout

Commit compares owner generation and inventory/root/ledger revisions under one admission gate; canonical mark authority unchanged; sweep/list/accounting mutation excludes commit and invalidates prepared views

Logical retirement retains held-block charge until backend-specific physical free acknowledgement; void code-free return discards munmap/VirtualFree status; metadata snapshots grant no payload authority; raw users/root and scan writers close first; foreign release and native allocator integrity remain explicit
Close new grants atomically against reservation/admission; retain pending and active writer plus borrower debt; callbacks cannot reopen retired generation; no scan grant before root and write closure
Still preparation, foreign cleanup, native borrower drain and retained capacity charged exactly once before backing release

callers.actualChain: alloc_scmobj_still -> aligned heap -> deferred charge -> still chain
callers.hazard: Capture unknown result before existing counter/list update; stop alone cannot recover pointer
callers.replacement: Managed intent plus backing identity before exposure

callers.actualChain: VM precharge or GC -> aligned heap -> failure subtract words
callers.hazard: Deferred old words differ from new grant; aggregate GC request has no per-intent identity
callers.replacement: Exact grant receipt; no whole aggregate refund

callers.actualChain: unmarked chain -> release_foreign -> free aligned heap -> recount
callers.hazard: User C may reenter; return ignored by caller; physical release status unavailable
callers.replacement: Retire/list unlink and release permit before call; separate destructor and backing outcomes

callers.actualChain: free_still_objs -> free aligned heap; then cleanup_rc
callers.hazard: Stop or shutdown does not turn unknown free into success
callers.replacement: Common release registry; cleanup waits outside gate or refuses completion

callers.actualChain: msection grow/shrink/cleanup and psection allocation/free use SAME heap wrapper
callers.hazard: Global wrapper replacement would mix still, movable and permanent capacity domains
callers.replacement: Backend receipt may be shared; domain-specific ledger adapters required

callers.actualChain: aligned pointer -> stored container -> heap route
callers.hazard: Logical base is not native free argument; lowlevel exec changes backend
callers.replacement: Snapshot exact container/range and backend before release, outside freed payload

callers.actualChain: code alloc -> mmap plus two header words; code free -> munmap, or VirtualAlloc/Free, or malloc/free
callers.hazard: munmap and VirtualFree results discarded; fallback/TempNewHandle are configuration-dependent
callers.replacement: Status-preserving adapters selected by effective profile; no unsupported branch admission

callers.actualChain: malloc/free via exported/debug macros; RC and many OS buffers share wrappers
callers.hazard: Debug log after malloc and before free; not a completion record; external embeddings remain open
callers.replacement: Keep unmanaged entry points until every consumer classified; no process-wide receipt claim

callers.actualChain: Scheme executable-path users -> C primitive -> _NSGetExecutablePath growth -> direct malloc/free
callers.hazard: Bypasses generic allocation wrappers; conversion can allocate Scheme objects while native path buffer remains live
callers.replacement: Keep native path-buffer domain separate; backend interception alone cannot claim process-wide receipt closure
